description: Orrery's pipeline runs (the data runners and refresh jobs), from their logs: runs over 24 h, error and failure lines, log volume per container, and the recent and error lines themselves. Pick the environment at the top.
title: Orrery — Pipelines

panels.title: Pipeline runs · 24h
panels.description: The panel shows the total number of pipeline runs in the last 24 hours, including both runner executions and data refresh jobs. A higher number indicates more activity, while a sudden drop may suggest a pause or failure in pipeline execution.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:pipeline | stats count_uniq(container) if (container:~"orrery-pipeline-runner-.*") runner_runs, count() if (job:orrery-data-refresh AND _msg:"[refresh-prod-data]" AND _msg:"launches.json") refresh_runs | math runner_runs + refresh_runs as runs

panels.title: Error / failure lines · 24h
panels.description: Pipeline log lines in the last 24 hours that match error, panic, traceback or failed. A word match, not a severity: a jump is worth a look in the list below.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:pipeline AND _msg:~"(?i)error|panic|traceback|failed" | stats count() errs

panels.title: Log lines · 24h
panels.description: The panel shows the total number of log lines generated by the pipeline in the last 24 hours. A higher number indicates increased activity or potential issues in the pipeline.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:pipeline | stats count() lines

panels.title: Pipeline log volume / min (per container)
panels.description: The panel shows the number of log lines generated per minute by each container in the pipeline, grouped by job. A higher value indicates more log activity in that container, while a sudden increase may suggest a change in workload or behavior.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:pipeline | stats by (container, job) count() lines

panels.title: Recent pipeline logs
panels.description: Every pipeline log line in this environment, newest first: the runners' and the data refresh's output.

panels.title: Error / failure lines
panels.description: The pipeline log lines matching error, panic, traceback or failed, newest first. Read it to see what failed.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:pipeline AND _msg:~"(?i)error|panic|traceback|failed"
